Mabosstiff

Dark

Paldea · Generation 9

Mabosstiff is a Dark-type Boss Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 61 kg. It evolves from Maschiff. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 505.
